text:
kevin: us-west-2 gpu nodepool at 98% and queue backlog exploding. Seen large spike starting ~15m ago :fire:
eng-oncall-bot: [ALERT] GPU_NODEPOOL_HIGH: us-west-2/gpu-dense at 98% utilization (pods waiting: 73)
olivia: oncall here, looking. cluster-autoscaler didn't start new nodes? checking logs
raj: CA logs show 'no suitable node group' for pods with nodeSelector: gpu-type=rtx-a10 and tolerations. quota + taints causing backoff.
marta: that quota bump request we submitted last week hasn't approved yet — cloud quotas at limit for region
kevin: can we temporarily relax nodeSelector on lower-priority jobs to allow packing on g4dn pool?
olivia: yes for short term. I'll add toleration exceptions for batch/training-k8s jobs. patching now
sophie: putting quick command here, do this on k8s control plane:
```
kubectl patch pod -n ml-training ${POD} -p '{"spec":{"nodeSelector":null}}'
kubectl cordon node/<bad-node>
kubectl drain node/<bad-node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```
raj: note: many jobs are using local gpu drivers which fail on node type mismatch. we should only relax for jobs with image:redwood/ml-train:v2
olivia: rolling a label-based AdmissionReview to allow migration for that image only. Pushing policy in 2 mins.
eng-oncall-bot: action_taken: cordoned 3 nodes, evicted 18 pods. Autoscaler requested scale-up to 60 nodes but cloud rejected due to quota
kevin: cloud support pinged, also opening emergency capacity ticket to increase GPU quota in us-west-2
marta: temporary mitigation: migrating low-priority jobs to us-east-1 spot pool could help but network egress and data locality will spike costs
sophie: for now we should mark this as P1 incident. Assigning Eng Oncall + Infra.
raj: I'm throttling scheduler admission for new training jobs via rate limiter: limit=5/min
olivia: implemented rate limit. New job submissions will queue in jobs-service - reducing pressure.
kevin: after ~12m we see backlog drop to 22 waiting pods. utilization down to 86%.
eng-oncall-bot: [RECOVERY] GPU_NODEPOOL_RECOVERING: waiting pods down to 22, nodepool utilization 86%
marta: still seeing one runaway job hogging 4 GPUs; its pod keeps respawning. logs show OOM loop from dataset loader
sophie: I killed the pod and scaled its deployment to 0, will investigate later. FWIW it's a customer training job (id: cust-983)
kevin: good. keep it stopped. We'll refund or credit as needed.
olivia: filing post-incident followups: 1) quota escalation automation 2) better autoscaler node-group matching rules 3) tighten job admission policies 4) runbook update for cross-region spillover
raj: + add preflight check in job submit API that warns if required nodeSelector unavailable
marta: cost note: using us-east spot will add ~18% egress/storage cost per TB and preemptible risk. Ops to approve
kevin: cloud quota increased by support (temporary) to allow scale to 70 nodes. Monitoring for 30m.
eng-oncall-bot: incident_status: stabilized. attendees: kevin, olivia, raj, marta, sophie. followups created.
sophie: creating a postmortem doc and RFC for permanent mitigation. tagging @product and @finance for cost approval
kevin: thanks everyone. closing Slack thread; we'll meet for 30m postmortem at 16:30 UTC
marta: meeting added. :white_check_mark:
